info.prompt: The interface unfolds as a fusion of medieval alchemy diagrams and cybernetic augmentation schematics—bone-white UI panels edged in gilded circuitry hover above a depthless black void, their surfaces displaying crystalline dice encased in amber-lit specimen jars, while neon magenta data streams cascade down like digital stained glass, intersecting with cyan pulse waves that throb in time with an unseen heartbeat monitor, the whole system watched over by a skeletal clockwork angel whose wings are made of oscilloscope tracings.
